title: Barcelona Surprise Proposal
text: Mische, the photographer we were paired with was an absolute dream to work with ! Start to finish she put my mind at ease going into a very special and nerve racking moment in my life. She was attentive , friendly , kind and overall one of the most professional photographers I’ve had the pleasure of dealing with. Mische stayed far enough to not arouse suspicion, yet kept constant communication to let me know all was going just as planned, Mische brought an eye for the perfect scenes, poses and direction for our special moment. author: Dion_S

title: Great experience
text: Our photographer was great! She took all kinds of pictures and had great ideas for really bringing out the wonder in an already dream setting!
author: Max_E

title: Amazing and professional!
text: Alicia, was very informative on the area, spoke multiple languages fluently. She was especially flexible making adjustments to time and location due to last minute changes related to the Cloudstrike IT issues at airports delaying my girlfriends flight for the proposal. Never complained always with a smile. She is the best!
author: michael_g

title: A wonderful experience
text: We had such a great experience with our photographer, Mike, at Park Guell! He was knowledgeable, personable, and knew his way around the area and the best spots to utilize for photos. We are so excited to see our photos as we know they will be perfect because of his attentiveness to lighting and surroundings. We would recommend him to all of our friends on their visits here!
author: Preston_P

title: Mische was absolutely amazing!
text: Mische was INCREDIBLE! She made such a special moment even more special. She was dedicated to blending in and not spoiling the moment and also was so excited for us when it happened. Her pictures are amazing and high quality, and she made sure we felt comfortable and got every picture we wanted. 10/10 would recommend.
author: Izaak_D

title: Outstanding job
text: I cannot describe how wonderful our experience with Mish was front start to finish. Mish managed to capture such special moments of our engagement photos at the Sagrada Familia. I would highly recommend Mish for your special moments or occasions!
author: Angelito_A

title: Excellent experience
text: Mish was a fantastic photographer.  I hired her for a surprise engagement.  She was very discrete and the photos were excellent.  Not only was she an amazing photographer but an excellent tour guide and very knowledgeable on the best places and light for photos.
author: Daniel_S

title: AMAZING PROPOSAL PHOTOGRAPHER
text: Our photographer was amazing. Very professional and really helped make the moment truly special for us.
author: Kyle_W

title: 10/10 Amazing Experience
text: Our photographer Mische was absolutely amazing. She made the whole experience even more amazing with her excitement and enthusiasm and she took amazing photographs! Could not recommend her more highly.
author: Ross_P
